mf_reader_check.note: descriptive MODEL_FIT out-of-fold readers; never a decision input

ALT.operation: NEURAL_RAW's own recipe continued beyond 80 steps (RAW_J, rho 1), checkpoints every 10 steps S90..S400

CTRL.operation: SEX-blind subtractive-dithered quantization of NEURAL_RAW's occupation output (income passed through bitwise; sar.ctlkit DQ_GRID_FINE, tag SAR_DQ_FB_S1; basis on the cross-fitted RAWJ E2 outputs)

recipe.income: START's income vector, frozen bitwise (deployed: NEURAL_RAW rho 1 E2; fold k: the fold's cross-fitted RAW-J E2)
recipe.objective: CE_occ + lambda [Phi(D_occ / sqrt 2) - 1/2 + Phi(D_pair / sqrt 2) - 1/2]; D_v^2 = Delta_v^T (S_v + eps_v I)^-1 Delta_v on degree-2 polynomial features of the standardized logit differences (FB_PFD_v1 functions); the frozen income logit difference enters D_pair as released
recipe.occupation_start: START's occupation network (deployed: NEURAL_RAW rho 1 E2; fold k: the fold's cross-fitted RAW-J E2)

selection.rule: k* = the largest checkpoint S_k (every 10 steps) such that S_10..S_k all keep estimate + 2 household-clustered SE <= BUDGET_OCC on the five occupation components of the MODEL_FIT out-of-fold paired spend over the fold start (the U0 recipe; folds SAR_xf_FB_S<v>); the income vector is START's (not spent by the operation)
